description: Modify the NativeAgent to support working with multiple projects simultaneously instead of being limited to a single project. The agent should maintain project-specific contexts per session, enabling future global ACP connection sharing capabilities.
functional_requirements: Remove the current one-to-one mapping between NativeAgent and project instances
Implement session-based project tracking within the NativeAgent
Maintain backward compatibility with existing agent-server interactions
Ensure tests are updated to validate multi-project functionality
Update agent UI components to handle multiple project contexts
Modify evaluation CLI to work with the new multi-project agent architecture
